label: 隱藏懸浮鈕
prompt:
A single game-item icon illustration of one simple non-realistic EYE-OFF interface symbol sculpted from thick matte clay: a broad sage-green almond-shaped eye aperture with a cream eye center and one sage-green circular pupil, crossed cleanly through its center by ONE thick coral-red DIAGONAL SLASH running bottom-left to top-right. This is a functional visibility-off icon only, NOT a character eye or face. Keep eye and slash instantly recognizable. No realistic iris, skin, eyelashes, human features, leaves, pouches, lids, seeds or characters. Render in exactly the same visual family as the THREE attached approved reference images: reference 1 golden planter D for matte volume and lighting, reference 2 red mushroom for softly painted 3D illustration, reference 3 related approved function icon for visual weight. References guide STYLE, do not copy their objects unless the subject explicitly calls for them.

Soft matte clay-like 3D, smooth plump rounded volumes, gentle top-left key light, softly painted core shading, a faint soft highlight, crisp clean silhouette with NO outline. No texture noise. Palette: warm honey-gold #F5C55A (light #FFE7A0, shade #C98F2A), sage green, warm browns, cream #FFF1DB, coral red #F36C63 as the only high-saturation accent. Never shiny metal, chrome or plastic; no specular glare. A thick simple readable silhouette, one main object with at most one or two supporting details, no tiny decorative marks. At 96px all key parts must remain legible.

Centered square canvas, 1254x1254 transparent RGBA PNG. Object fills about 84%, about 8% safe margin on EVERY side. No background, frame, enclosing circle, scene, ground plane or cast shadow outside the object; only an extremely faint contact shadow is allowed.

DO NOT add faces, mouths, anthropomorphic bodies, hands, arms, feet, characters, text, letters, numbers, fake writing, sparkles, glitter, thick black outlines, sticker borders, flat vector, line-art, emoji style, glass glare or neon. Only ONE icon, never a contact sheet or comparisons. Latest explicit user direction overrides earlier object-only examples. This is the THIRD concept round: prioritize literal recognition of the requested FUNCTION, keep a simple solid 3D silhouette at24/28dp. No previous rejected props. A standard functional visibility eye IS explicitly requested and allowed. Never draw eyes, face, arms or a mouth on the mushroom, pot or another character.
